summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster from scratch on node1/node2/node3 (AlmaLinux 9), resolving SELinux and firewalld blockers to get SST working, seeded appdb.orders with committed data, then performed a full cold maintenance-window shutdown of all three nodes followed by a clean cold restart (bootstrap from the highest-seqno node, SST/IST rejoin of the others), confirming all committed writes survived and all three members resumed serving. Finally executed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot protocol on all three nodes, proving changed boot_id and full cluster/quorum/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed mariadb-server, mariadb-server-galera, mariadb-backup on node1/node2/node3
Opened firewalld ports 3306,4444,4567/tcp+udp,4568 on all three nodes
Wrote /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on each node with correct per-node wsrep_node_address/name and fixed wsrep_provider path to /usr/lib64/galera/libgalera_smm.so
Set SELinux boolean daemons_enable_cluster_mode=on persistently on all three nodes to fix a mariadb-backup SST connectto denial
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 via galera_new_cluster, set root password, created sstuser and appuser, created appdb.orders with 3 seed rows
Joined node2 and node3 to the cluster via mariabackup SST; verified wsrep_cluster_size=3 and full data replication on all nodes
Enabled mariadb.service for boot-time start on all three nodes
Inserted an additional pre-maintenance committed row (order-4) and confirmed it replicated to all nodes
Performed the maintenance-window shutdown: stopped mariadb on node3, then node2, then node1 (cluster fully down)
Identified node1 as the highest-seqno node (grastate.dat safe_to_bootstrap:1) and re-bootstrapped it, confirming all 4 rows present
Started node2 and node3, confirmed rejoin and a healthy 3/3 Synced/Primary cluster with all 4 rows present on every node
Captured pre-restart boot_id baseline on all three nodes plus healthy cluster/data proof
Rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time via `reboot`, polling each until reachable again
Verified changed boot_id on each node after its reboot, and verified mariadb auto-started with wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, Primary, and all 4 rows intact after each individual node's restart

evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped, node2 and node3 joined via SST; node3 shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, status Primary, all Synced

evidence.requirement: Application data present before maintenance window
evidence.summary: appdb.orders created with 3 seed rows on node1; order-4-pre-maintenance inserted just before shutdown

evidence.requirement: Full cluster shutdown for maintenance window
evidence.summary: mariadb stopped (inactive) on node3, node2, then node1 in sequence -- entire cluster down

evidence.requirement: Cluster restart after maintenance with all committed writes intact and all three members serving
evidence.summary: node1 re-bootstrapped from highest-seqno grastate (seqno 20, safe_to_bootstrap:1) and showed all 4 rows immediately; node2 and node3 restarted and rejoined; all three nodes independently confirm wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced, Primary, and all 4 order rows
